command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
n=0
for f in /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/*.ko /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/*.ko; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  n=$((n+1))
  [ "$n" -le 256 ] || exit 65
  matched=0
  for symbol in tztv_system_serdes_lock_check sdp_ocif_lock_get sdp_serdes_lock tztv_sys_is_oc_support; do
    if LC_ALL=C grep -q "$symbol" "$f"; then
      echo "@@ MATCH $symbol $f"
      matched=1
    fi
  done
  if [ "$matched" = 1 ]; then
    echo "@@ MODULE $f"
    wc -c < "$f"
    sha256sum "$f"
  fi
done
echo "@@ SCANNED $n"
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Finite passive search for four SerDes callback/caller names over two fixed module directories, <=256 files, no call/control/load/trace. Physical panel unobserved.
